- Identify GrandTotal.Amount:
  - Found "Gesamtbetrag ... -33,75 EUR" and final line shows "-33,75 EUR" → GrandTotal.Amount = -33.75 (retain decimals).

- Identify VAT groups and rates:

- Consistency checks / no inference:

  - Percent returned without "%" as number (0).
  - All extracted numeric values kept to same decimal places as source (two decimals).
